title: Causal test-run diagnostics can retain awaiting_receipt after the original receipt has been read
outcome: After the ordinary causal completion scan validates the retained original send receipt and produces a Ready plan, the pending diagnostic stops asking for that receipt and reports the next deciding condition.
acceptance: A normal retained original relay receipt followed by a Ready plan makes a diagnostic read before the origin pull show awaiting_completion with origin_completion_available, with a behavioral regression.
The Ready scan still preserves recorded origin and admission failures and does not change receipt custody, retry order or pending row retirement.
